name: ai-status-hub
description: Monitor AI coding assistant usage and rate limits across Codex, Claude, Kimi, GLM, and Cursor

commands.title: AI Status Hub: Set API Key

aiStatusHub.provider.description: Which coding assistant to monitor. auto: detect from local session directories.

aiStatusHub.displayMode.description: Status bar display mode. percent: show percentage with mini bar. absolute: show used/limit count.

aiStatusHub.language.description: Display language. auto: follow VS Code locale. en: English. zh-CN: Simplified Chinese.

aiStatusHub.statusBar.alignment.description: Status bar alignment. left: aligned to the left side of the status bar. right: aligned to the right side.

aiStatusHub.updateAnimationDurationMs.description: Duration of the moon update animation in milliseconds. Range: 500–10000. When new data arrives during animation, the timer resets.

aiStatusHub.updateAnimationIntervalMs.description: Frame interval of the moon update animation in milliseconds. Range: 100–2000. Controls how fast the moon phases cycle.

aiStatusHub.statusBar.utilizationColor.l.description: Status bar text color when utilization is below 20%. Hex color string.
Status bar text color when utilization is 20%–40%. Hex color string.
Status bar text color when utilization is 40%–60%. Hex color string.
Status bar text color when utilization is 60%–80%. Hex color string.

aiStatusHub.statusBar.utilizationColor.g.description: Status bar text color when utilization is 80% or above. Hex color string.

aiStatusHub.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: API refresh interval in seconds. Range: 30–∞. Long tick fetches quota from API.

aiStatusHub.shortRefreshIntervalSeconds.description: Local estimation refresh interval in seconds. Range: 1–60. Short tick reads local JSONL and estimates usage without API call.

aiStatusHub.dataRetentionDays.description: Local usage data retention period in days. Range: 30–3650. Older entries are discarded during scan.

aiStatusHub.weeklyBudget.description: Weekly budget in configured currency. 0 means disabled. When cost7d exceeds this value, a warning is shown.

aiStatusHub.heatmapDays.description: Number of days to show in the usage history heatmap.

aiStatusHub.heatmapCycles5h.description: Number of 5h cycles to display in the heatmap. Range: 1–60.

aiStatusHub.heatmapCycles7d.description: Number of 7d cycles to display in the heatmap. Range: 1–60.

aiStatusHub.heatmapCycles30d.description: Number of 30d cycles to display in the heatmap. Range: 1–60.

aiStatusHub.costCurveMaxPoints.description: Maximum number of data points for the cost curve. Range: 200–20000.

aiStatusHub.chartHeightRatio.description: Height ratio for dashboard charts (canvas height = width * ratio).

aiStatusHub.dashboard.memoryDetailMaxRow.description: Maximum number of rows to pass to Dashboard memory detail tables.

aiStatusHub.dashboard.memoryDetailDispla.description: Maximum visible rows in Dashboard detail tables before scrollbar appears.

aiStatusHub.dashboard.memoryDetailCellMa.description: Maximum characters displayed per cell in Dashboard detail tables.

aiStatusHub.apiHistoryMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of estimator history entries to keep in memory.

aiStatusHub.apiHistoryPersistOnExit.description: Persist API history to disk JSONL when the extension deactivates.

aiStatusHub.currency.description: Currency for cost display. auto: infer from provider (Codex/Claude/Cursor → USD, Kimi/GLM → CNY). USD: US Dollar. CNY: Chinese Yuan.
